a.xlink:title: Test if the compiler has reached the specified stage.
Verify that the compiler has reached the specified stage.
First pass: Create a FileStructure that represents the module, its packages, their classes,...
Verify that the compiler has not been invalidated.
This stage finishes the compilation by emitting any necessary code and any remaining structures.
Second pass: Link the modules together based on their declared dependencies.
Third pass: Resolve all of the globally-visible dependencies and names.
Fourth pass: Resolve all types and constants.
